description: Natural-language date parser — Turn phrases like 'next friday at 3pm PST', 'in 3 business days', 'Dec 10', 'end of month', '2 hours ago' or 'tomorrow 9am' into an exact timestamp: UTC + local ISO with offset, epoch, weekday, all-day flag, business-day and US federal holiday check, relative 'in 5 days', matched/ignored words, assumptions and confidence. Offline, DST-aware via IANA zones. Optional: tz (IANA zone or PST/EST/CT etc, default UTC), now (ISO reference time), calendar=us|none. Price: $0.002 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: time_parse
